ruleSets.description: Turn whole rule sets on (true) or off (false). Everything is on by default.

rules.description: Single rules: true / false, or an object with enabled and severity. A rule setting wins over its rule set.

oneOf.description: Further keys are rule parameters (e.g. a limit) for rules that have them.

exclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to this folder) that are never analyzed.

compileCommands.description: Path of compile_commands.json, relative to this folder. Default: compile_commands.json, build/, out/ or cmake-build-debug/.

includePaths.description: Extra include folders (relative to this folder), added after those from the compile database.

defines.description: Extra macros, like -D on the compiler command line.

deviations.description: Accepted findings with a reason (shown as justified).
